package.description: Vehicle motion cues for Windows that help prevent car sickness.

en-US.description: Vehicle motion cues for Windows that help prevent car sickness.
en-US.longDescription: SteadyCues puts softly moving dots at the edges of your screen that follow the car's motion, so passengers can read and work without getting car sick. Laptops without a motion sensor can use a phone as the sensor over Wi-Fi or a hotspot.
en-US.name: SteadyCues
